issues.on_page: Original Budget 86,665 (no Final Budget column printed)
issues.issue: The all-funds budget schedule prints only an Original Budget column. budget_final for detail[45]-detail[48] (Public works 86,665, Water 127,470, Sewer 26,530, Solid waste 59,230) is the original budget. The figures match the page, but the column is not labelled final.

One printed line mixes salaries and benefits. It is recorded as salaries and wages for General, Park, Pool and RV Park (detail[9]-detail[12]) with no review flag. Defensible, but benefits are inside it.

issues.on_page: Fund balances - September 30, 2024 464,935 / Net position - September 30, 2025 525,908 (modified cash basis)
issues.issue: The report is cash basis, but measure is 'net position'. The balance includes certificates of deposit 123,438, which the p8 cash flow statement excludes from cash (cash 344,502 to 402,470). Defensible because the statement rolls forward net position, but it differs from the rule that cash basis means measure 'cash'.
